home_sub: Mark where you speak, read your script when the light is green, and get a finished video.
s1_p: Choose any video. Paste your text: a blank line starts a new part.
s2_p: Play the video and press M where you start talking and M again where you stop.
s3_p: Red = wait, yellow = get ready, green = speak. Then press Make video.
tl_help: Click = go there · drag a part's edge = change its time · mouse wheel = zoom · K or Space = play / pause · ← → = 1 s (Shift = 0.1 s)
mode_fit_p: The video stays the same length. Each recording starts at its mark. A recording that is too long is played up to 25% faster.
mode_wait_p: When you talk longer than a part, the picture stops at the end of the part until you finish. Best for lessons, slides and screen recordings.
duck_p: Make the original sound quieter under my voice
speed_fit_p: Play a too-long recording a little faster (max 1.25×)
f_folder: 3. Keep the project in this folder
f_script: 4. Your script (you can add or change it later)
f_script_p: A blank line starts a new part. You can put the time in front: [0:01 - 0:03] Hello!
paste_replace: Replace all parts (otherwise the text goes into the parts you already have, in order)
err_server: SpeakSync is not answering. Close the window and start SpeakSync again.
video_missing: The video file is not where it was.
no_parts: No parts yet. Play the video and press M where you start speaking, and M again where you stop. Or use Script ▾ to paste your text.
text_ph: What you will say here… (empty = free talk)
del_rec_q: This part has a recording. Remove the part? (The recording file is kept in the takes folder.)
clear_q: Remove all parts? Recordings stay in the takes folder.
l_wait_s: Press Space when you are ready
l_recorded_s: Recorded. Space = record again, ↓ = next part, L = listen
l_ready_s: Start talking when the light is green
l_speak_s: Read the bright text. The bar shows the time left.
l_finish_s: The part's time is over - end your sentence
l_hold_s: Take your time and finish your sentence
l_saved_s: Do not speak. The next part comes.
l_done_s: Every part is recorded. Go to 3 - Make video.
mic_bad: No microphone. Allow the microphone and try again.
free_talk_long: No text for this part - say what you want while the light is green.
no_parts_rec: No marked parts yet. Go to 1 - Mark first.
need_mark: This part has no time yet. Mark it in tab 1 first.
rec_quiet: Part {n}: almost no voice was heard. Check the microphone and press R.
mk_untimed: {n} part(s) have no time and are left out.
st_mix: Putting your voice on the video
mk_srt: Subtitles (.srt) are saved next to it.
about_p: Record your own voice over any video, part by part. Free for everyone. Nothing is uploaded - your videos and your voice stay on your computer.
help_html:
How SpeakSync works

  1. New project: choose your video and paste your script. A blank line starts a new part. You can write the time in front: [0:01 - 0:03] Hello!
  2. 1 · Mark: play the video. Press M where you start speaking and M again where you stop. The text goes into the parts in order. Drag the edges on the time line to fix a time.
  3. 2 · Record: press Space. Red = do not speak. Yellow 3-2-1 = get ready. Green = read the bright text. The bar shows the time left. It stops by itself when you are quiet; the next part comes. R = record again, L = listen.
  4. 3 · Make video: choose where to save. You also get subtitles (.srt).

Voice fits the video: the video does not change. Good for films and clips.
Video waits for me: when you talk longer, the picture waits. Good for lessons and screen recordings.

Tip: use headphones if you turn on “Hear the video”.
